recs.title: Switch ad sets to the most value goal
recs.lift: You could get 7% higher ROAS by using the maximise value of conversions performance goal
recs.body: Campaigns using the Maximize value of conversions performance goal get higher ROAS compared to the Maximize number of conversions performance goal. About maximizing the value of conversions

recs.title: Turn on Advantage+ creative enhancements
recs.lift: Automatically optimise your ad with 4 more Advantage+ creative enhancements
recs.body: We'll deliver different creative variations of your ad when we predict that it could help improve performance with: visual touch-ups, text improvements, add overlays and flexible media.

recs.title: Send purchases through Conversions API too
recs.lift: You could get a lower cost per result by adding Conversions API with Meta integration
recs.body: Add Conversions API with Meta to improve Purchase event coverage and lower your cost per result.

recs.title: Combine ad sets that compete with each other
recs.lift: Combine similar ad sets impacted by fragmentation
recs.body: Some of your ad sets have similar setups and creatives, but different audiences. As a result, they may take longer to exit the learning phase and spend more budget before performance has optimized. To avoid this, combine your similar ad sets into one ad set.

recs.title: Try Advantage+ audience
recs.lift: Using Advantage+ audience may improve performance
recs.body: With Advantage+ audience, ads are shown beyond some of your settings when it's likely to improve performance. You can still limit ads to specific locations and people above a minimum age. Learn more

recs.title: Try Advantage+ catalog ads
recs.lift: You could get a lower cost per action by using Advantage+ catalog
recs.body: Create a campaign to deliver personalized ads to new and existing interested shoppers based on their behaviors, interests, and intent. About Meta Advantage+ catalog ads

recs.title: Track sales that start in WhatsApp or DMs
recs.lift: You could lower your cost per purchase by 24% by using a messaging partner or Meta setup
recs.body: Send messaging events through Meta or with a messaging partner, and select the Maximise purchases through messaging performance goal to help lower costs.
